evidence.quote: GPU Memory 48GB GDDR6 with error-correcting code (ECC)

notes.zh: 回答工作站单卡的 48GB 档位：与消费卡同容量的区别在 ECC 显存与 300W 功耗上限，更适合长时间满载与多卡并排。不回答多卡训练效率：该卡同样没有 NVLink，多卡只能走 PCIe，张量并行会受带宽限制。
notes.en: Answers the 48 GB tier for workstation cards: what separates it from a consumer card of the same capacity is ECC memory and a 300 W ceiling, which suits sustained load and side-by-side installation. It does not answer multi-card training efficiency: this card also lacks NVLink, so cards communicate over PCIe and tensor parallelism is bandwidth-bound.

specs.form factor: 4.4 in H x 10.5 in L, dual-slot, active cooling
